question: Should the bundled Microsoft Teams plugin permanently support multiple bot identities through channels.msteams.accounts, root-setting inheritance, and account-scoped auth and state?
rationale: The implementation is technically credible, but code review cannot choose the permanent configuration, inheritance, upgrade, and support contract for a bundled channel.

options.title: Close pending sponsorship
options.body: Close without rejecting the idea, and reopen when a Teams/channel owner explicitly sponsors the proposed contract and support burden.

options.title: Sponsor current contract
options.body: Accept accounts/defaultAccount plus legacy root compatibility as the supported direction and move the PR into final owner and upgrade review.

options.title: Request a staged design
options.body: Keep the feature direction but require a narrower first PR or design issue that settles config inheritance and state migration before the full runtime expansion.

recommendation.title: Close pending sponsorship
recommendation.body: Close without rejecting the idea, and reopen when a Teams/channel owner explicitly sponsors the proposed contract and support burden.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Teams configuration and policy history plus the direct review request make this the strongest available routing candidate for the product decision.
